title: Hostel facilities
content: Bennett University's current hostel page describes well-furnished triple-sharing rooms with air conditioning, comfortable beds and storage; common washrooms are regularly cleaned. Hostels also have recreational common rooms, round-the-clock operations, power backup, centralised temperature control, routine maintenance and a dedicated safety team. Students have access to sports, wellness and fitness facilities. The current 2026-27 page also states that on-campus hostel accommodation is currently full for students admitted or taking admission after 25 July 2026.
